name: Medieval Fantasy
summary: Medieval England and influences from medieval English history are the most common, but the degree of influence varies wildly, with some borrowing from elements from the Renaissance period, most notably in the style of the weapons and armor used around that time.
description: Medieval England and influences from medieval English history are the most common, but the degree of influence varies wildly, with some borrowing from elements from the Renaissance period, most notably in the style of the weapons and armor used around that time. In recent times there has been an effort to include non-English Medieval influences.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Escapism, chivalry

visualDNA.colour: Purple, red, blue, green, brown, tan

fashion.Overview: Medieval Fantasy fashion are influenced by the silhouettes of the Middle Ages, but also necessarily historically accurate. Polyester stretch velvet, for example, is often used in film and television productions because of its low cost compared to natural silk velvet.

sounds: Hildegard von Blingin' and other Bardcore music
